# smolvm skill packets

> Tested procedures, one task each, with their scripts. The flat pages in this directory are
> the reference for each feature.

- [install](install/SKILL.md): installing smolvm and proving the host can boot a microVM
- [teardown](teardown/SKILL.md): what state exists, where it lives, and how to leave nothing running
- [throwaway-machine](throwaway-machine/SKILL.md): running untrusted code in a throwaway machine, with egress granted one host at a time
